description: LADWP Solar Incentive Program is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. The Solar Incentive Program offers customers an incentive to offset the cost of installing a solar rooftop system on their home or business. LADWP has been helping customers to go solar since 1999. This metric measures the Net Energy Metering (NEM) Installed Capacity (Kilowatts). Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category City Infrastructure & Service Requests. Its tags are local solar, net energy metering, sip. The table has 2 columns. Attribution on the portal: LADWP. The portal shows 2018-09-04 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
